technique_name: Suggest a creative project for a group of 6 marketers.
description: A great creative project for a group of 6 marketers would be to create an original logo for a product launch or promotional event. Each team member should choose a different aspect of the project that speaks to their strengths. For example, one person could design the logo, another could develop a color palette, and so on.
